block.x_twitter.model.title: X (Twitter)
block.x_twitter.model.description: Publish, search and read posts on X through the X API v2.
block.x_twitter.security_hint: Tokens stay in the wallet. Nothing is published until Allow posting is enabled.
block.x_twitter.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.x_twitter.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.x_twitter.help_enabled: Off by default. While off, no request reaches X and the wallet is never read.
block.x_twitter.help_secret_ref: Wallet reference holding the OAuth 2.0 user grant (access_token, refresh_token, client_id). Needed for post and delete_post; never the token itself.
block.x_twitter.help_bearer_secret_ref: Optional wallet reference holding the app's bearer token. When set, searches and lookups use it instead of the user grant.
block.x_twitter.help_operation: Used when a request gives no operation; plain text is its main parameter. post and delete_post need Allow writes.
block.x_twitter.help_allowed_operations: JSON array among ["post", "delete_post", "search_recent", "get_user", "user_posts"]. The default operation is always allowed.
block.x_twitter.help_page_size: max_results sent to X for searches and timelines, 10-100. Each post read counts against the access level's quota.
block.x_twitter.help_allow_writes: Off by default. Required for post and delete_post; nothing is published while it is off.
block.x_twitter.help_max_weighted_length: Weighted length checked before sending: 280 for most accounts, more for subscriptions that allow long posts. X makes the final check.
block.x_twitter.help_media_root: Only JPEG, PNG or WEBP files inside this directory can be attached. Empty disables images.
block.x_twitter.help_allow_delete: Separate switch for deleting posts by ID. X keeps no trash: a deletion is final.
block.x_twitter.help_max_pages: Pages per search or timeline; when reached, the result gives next_token to continue.
block.x_twitter.help_max_media_bytes: Larger images are refused before the wallet is read. X accepts images up to 5 MB.
block.x_twitter.help_timeout_sec: Total time for one operation, token refresh, image upload, pages and retries included.
block.x_twitter.help_max_retries: Reads retry after HTTP 429, 5xx or a lost connection; writes only after HTTP 429 or a connection that never opened.
block.x_twitter.help_max_retry_wait_sec: A Retry-After or rate-limit reset further away returns rate_limited instead of waiting.
block.x_twitter.help_max_request_bytes: Bound for the incoming request and for each JSON body sent to X.
block.x_twitter.help_max_response_bytes: Larger X responses are refused as protocol errors.
block.x_twitter.help_api_base_url: Keep https://api.x.com. Another origin receives the tokens; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.
block.x_twitter.help_ca_file: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
